bug: The element defaults of the original stylesheet were missing (button { border: none; background: transparent; color }, th/td, thead tr, tbody tr, table-layout, button:hover and a:hover background off). Every bordered button drew a 1px line the original does not: button-period-all was 51x30 with borderTopWidth 1px against 49x28 and 0px, and the page was 2335px tall against 2331px.
caught_by: parity style detector on home_d: 294 of 298 probes differed (style ratio 0.9866, pixel 0.037), first lines of home_d.style.diff naming the period buttons' w, h and borderTopWidth
fix: Added the rules to index.css inside @layer utilities, the position they hold in the original (after plain utilities, before hover and breakpoint variants). home_d then reported 0 of 298 probes and pixel 0.

bug: The ROI cell tested `roi != null`, so a trader whose roi is an explicit null got a dash. The original tests `roi !== undefined` and renders null as +0.0%. The recorded data has roi absent on 188 of 576 traders and never null, so no scenario could show it.
caught_by: by eye, comparing the cell against the original's chunk before the first gate run
fix: Moved the rule into roiText() in app/src/lib/format.ts; format.test.ts now asserts undefined gives a dash and null gives +0.0%.

bug: The referral effect posted /api/referral/visit every time it ran. React StrictMode runs an effect twice on mount in development, so a visit with ?ref= would have been registered twice.
caught_by: by eye, reading the hook against the original's run-once guard before the first gate run
fix: Landing logic moved to registerLanding() with a per-page-load visitSent flag; referral.test.ts asserts one POST across two calls, and a browser probe of /?ref=alice on the dev server (all /api calls intercepted) counted one visit POST.
